rules.name: CHOKE THE LAND WITH GREEN
rules.text: Whenever Invaders would Ravage or Build in a land with your [Sacred Site] , you may prevent it by destroying one of your [Presence] in that land.
rules.turn:
ravage-chosen C, is C L, spirit:special S choke-the-land, sacred-site S L
  ?[rng] Y
  !(yes-no Y)
  ~choke-ask S L ravage Y
-- ... and only a "yes" installs the exception. "by destroying one of your
-- Presence in that land" is its replacement.
ravage-chosen C, is C L, (choke-ask S L ravage Y), is Y yes, { ravage L => ~choke L }
-- "... or Build": same, asked at the start of the Build step
-- (the base has no build-target view, so its condition is restated here)
build-step, spirit:special S choke-the-land, sacred-site S L, has-invaders L,
  invader-card:build C, card:terrain C T, land:terrain L T
  ?[rng] Y
  !(yes-no Y)
  ~choke-ask S L build Y
build-step, (choke-ask S L build Y), is Y yes, { build L => ~choke L }
-- (the RHS may only use the intercepted tuple's variables, so the Spirit is
--  looked up again)
choke L, spirit:special S choke-the-land
  ?[rng] P
  !(presence-of S P, at P L)
  ~destroy-presence P
rules.evidence: seeds 3,6 answer yes: `_ravage_prime1 l2; choke l2; move g1 destroyed`, no `ravage l2`, l2 Blight stays 1; answer no: `ravage l2; damage-land l2 5`. Build: seed 1 yes on l2 -> `choke l2`, `build l1` still happens
rules.notes: An exception cannot be optional: once installed it always replaces, and a declined replacement cannot re-emit `ravage L` (it would be intercepted again and loop). So the 'may' is asked first (when the base chooses the land to Ravage -- ravage-chosen -- and at the start of the Build step), and only a 'yes' installs the exception. For Build the base has no build-target view, so its card/terrain/invaders condition is restated in the spirit file.

rules.name: STEADY REGENERATION
rules.text: When adding [Presence] to the board via Growth, you may optionally use your destroyed [Presence] . If the island is Healthy, do so freely. If the island is Blighted, doing so costs 1 Energy per destroyed [Presence] you add.
rules.turn:
growth S, add-presence S, spirit:special S steady-regeneration,
  presence-of S P, at P destroyed, island-state healthy
  / presence-source S P
-- "If the island is Blighted, doing so costs 1 Energy per destroyed
--  Presence you add."
growth S, add-presence S, spirit:special S steady-regeneration,
  presence-of S P, at P destroyed, island-state blighted, energy S E, ge E 1
  / presence-source S P
growth S, spirit:special S steady-regeneration, island-state blighted,
  placing S C X, is C P, at P destroyed, +energy-change S -1
rules.evidence: seed 5: `move g3 l3` -- the destroyed Presence g3 was added by Growth; other seeds chose g4 from the supply
rules.notes: core.t hard-codes `presence-of S P, at P supply` as the source of an added Presence (and, as written, moves EVERY supply Presence -- a core bug). core-green.t makes the source a choice over a presence-source view; then the rule is two added rows (Healthy: free; Blighted: offered only with Energy >= 1) plus a trigger that charges 1 Energy. 'via Growth' is checked by requiring the growth S episode to be alive in the acc body. The Blighted Island flip is not modeled (island-state is a fact).

base_ext: Energy (#acc energy); Growth reduced to `growth S, ~add-presence S`; island-state healthy fact (no Blight Card).

+presence-choice S L, is L X

+  !(presence-source S P)
+  ~placing S P X
+placing S C X, is C P, ~move P X

language_issues: Exceptions are unconditional: 'you may prevent it' must be decided by a choice placed before the intercepted tuple is emitted; deciding inside the replacement cannot fall back to the original (re-emission is re-intercepted).
A choice domain derived from an acc that depends on the choice's own follow-up episode is silently empty (my first yes-no acc keyed on choke-ask): the choice resolves to nothing with no warning.
